entries.title: Move the keys you keep in another tool into Secrets
entries.body: Settings → Secrets has Move from another tool, and command search has Move secrets from another tool. Either one starts a message to your first mate: name where your keys are now, such as a .env file or your Mac's Keychain, and one crewmate moves them. It finds only their names and asks Infinitary to bring them in, so you tick each key on Infinitary's own card and your crew never sees a value. What you had before stays where it was.
